alt: Screen recording of the Pohunek Companion app on demo data: it filters the session list, then opens a live terminal and scrolls through its history.
description: The session list puts the sessions that need you first, with a chip for the host.
Scrolling down hides the filter bar and scrolling up brings it back.
The Project chip opens a picker; typing narrows it and a tap picks a project.
The State chip limits the list to the sessions that need you, and Clear resets the filters.
A tap opens the session as a live terminal, and a fling scrolls through its history and back.
